description: This Java class 'InitializingHook' defines setup and teardown hooks for Cucumber-based tests, utilizing Spring environment and custom initializer factories to prepare test scenarios.

classes.name: InitializingHook
classes.description: Defines Cucumber hooks (@BeforeAll, @Before, @AfterAll) for initializing and resetting test environment setup.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Sets up global defaults for Fineract before all tests if enabled in properties.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up defaults for each individual scenario.

methods.name: afterAll
methods.description: Resets defaults after the entire test suite completes.
